subject: Onboarding credits expired during POC — request for one-time safety-net topup
messages:
From: Alyssa Young <alyssa@edgetech.io>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>
Cc: procure@edgetech.io <procure@edgetech.io>
Date: Sat, 17 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Onboarding credits expired during POC — request for one-time safety-net topup

Hi Mateo,

Quick context: we kicked off a short POC with Redwood in August and had a burst of activity the first two weeks. During a staffing shuffle our usage dropped off and our sandbox credits expired last month. We were mid-eval and a lot of work depends on keeping the sandbox live for a few more weeks so the team can finish model integration and latency tests.

Is there any one-time safety-net or onboarding top-up you can grant so the POC doesn't stall? We're not asking for an ongoing grant — just enough credits to finish the integration (~200k tokens estimated). If you need an internal sign-off or PO, I can loop procurement. I attached a short POC summary and our billing export showing usage.

Attachments: POC-summary.pdf (1 page), billing-export.csv (CSV export)

Thanks — really want to keep momentum on this.

— Alyssa Young
Head of ML Platform, EdgeTech Systems
alyssa@edgetech.io
+1 (415) 555-0123
From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Alyssa Young <alyssa@edgetech.io>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Oct 2026 10:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Onboarding credits expired during POC — request for one-time safety-net topup

Hi Alyssa — thanks for the note and the attachments. Appreciate the clear ask and the usage export.

Quick questions to speed this along:
- Can you confirm the EdgeTech account ID tied to the export (we saw two accounts under a similar name)?
- Is the 200k token estimate a high-water mark or a conservative finish estimate?
- Do you expect increased monthly usage after the POC (helpful for approval routing)?

I cc'd Monica from Customer Success and Ben from Finance so we can get an approval loop started. My suggestion is a one-time 200k token safety top-up tied to the current account, with an expiration of 30 days after grant (we can extend once if you hit delays). If Finance needs a short purchase approval form or a PO, Ben can advise.

If you prefer, I can issue a conditional promo code while we finalize paperwork — that usually unblocks hands-on work quickly.

Best,
Mateo Alvarez
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
mateo_alvarez@redwood.com
From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>

Hi Alyssa / Mateo — Monica here from CS. Reviewed the POC summary and the billing export. Proposal below: 

- One-time 200,000 token promo credited to the EdgeTech account ID you confirm below.
- Promo valid for 30 days from grant. If EdgeTech needs an additional 30-day extension, we will evaluate with APA (require brief sync).
- Attach a short approval form we use internally (MAM-approved-topup-form.pdf) — Finance/PM must sign off for any promotional grant over $800 equivalent.

Next steps:
1) Alyssa: confirm account ID & that the estimate is sufficient.
2) Ben/Finance: review and sign the attached approval form (simple yes/no + initials).
3) Mateo: once form is signed I will provision the promo code and share redemption steps.

Alyssa — fair ask and we can move quickly here. If you want the promo code immediately to unblock the engineers, we can issue it with a note that Finance will follow with the sign-off form.

Attachments: MAM-approved-topup-form.pdf (1 page)

Thanks,
Monica Patel
